findings.title: NetworkPolicy's namespaceSelector matches no namespace
findings.cause: container client exits because its connection to Service web times out: NetworkPolicy web-ingress allows ingress on port 8080 only from namespaces labelled name=kd-networkpolicy-namespace-label, and no namespace of the cluster has those labels, so the rule admits nothing and the connection is dropped (namespace kd-networkpolicy-namespace-label exists, and its labels are kubernetes.io/metadata.name=kd-networkpolicy-namespace-label); its log says: "wget: download timed out"; Deployment client has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container client exited with code 1 (Error), restarted 6 times
last lines of container client's log (current run)
evidence.detail:
Connecting to web (10.96.66.125:80)
wget: download timed out

evidence.what: NetworkPolicy web-ingress's ingress rule selects namespaces labelled name=kd-networkpolicy-namespace-label
evidence.command: kubectl get networkpolicy web-ingress -n kd-networkpolicy-namespace-label -o jsonpath='{.spec.ingress}'

evidence.what: none of the 166 namespaces has labels name=kd-networkpolicy-namespace-label

findings.fix: Select the namespace by the label Kubernetes sets on every namespace: namespaceSelector: {matchLabels: {kubernetes.io/metadata.name: kd-networkpolicy-namespace-label}} in NetworkPolicy web-ingress. Or add the label the policy expects (kubectl label namespace kd-networkpolicy-namespace-label name=kd-networkpolicy-namespace-label). For pods of the policy's own namespace a podSelector alone is enough.
